    content = f.read()

lines = content.split('\n')
code_start = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.startswith('import ') or line.startswith('from ') or line.startswith('class ') or line.startswith('def '):
        if i > 300:  # After docstring
            code_start = i
            break

print(f"Code starts around line {code_start}")
for i in range(max(0, code_start-2), min(len(lines), code_start+5)):
    print(f"{i+1}: {lines[i]}")
